title: Extract JSON Data
description: A local API at http://127.0.0.1:18082/users returns a JSON user list.
mission: Request the API, extract the admin user's name, and write it into answer.txt.
success: You requested and extracted the required JSON value.

lesson.what_happened: The HTTP response was structured JSON, so selecting by role was safer than text matching.
lesson.be_careful: Check HTTP errors before assuming the response has the expected schema.

hints: Request /users and inspect the JSON shape.
jq can iterate .users[] and select by .role.
Select role admin, then print .name with -r.
